name: mixed_case_is_preserved
why: the value is a digest; lowercasing it names a different credential

name: surrounding_whitespace_is_trimmed
why: both sides trim, so a padded value must still join

name: base64_padding_is_significant
why: trailing = is part of the value and must not be stripped

name: an_empty_token_yields_no_key
why: an absent credential is not a session key of the empty string

name: whitespace_only_yields_no_key
why: trimming to empty is the same as absent

name: a_missing_field_yields_no_key
why: an audit entry with no hashed_token has no credential to group on

name: a_non_string_yields_no_key
why: both sides require a string; coercing a number would invent a key
